message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && mkdir -p /tmp/mrbobj && rm -f /tmp/mrbobj/*.o
# Compile all .pi files into .o with gcc + asan
count=0
fail=0
for pi in $(find build/host -name "*.pi"); do
  base=$(echo "$pi" | sed 's|build/host/||;s|/|_|g;s|\.pi||')
  out="/tmp/mrbobj/${base}.o"
  if gcc -c -O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -DMRB_USE_RATIONAL -DMRB_USE_COMPLEX "$pi" -o "$out" 2>/tmp/err.txt; then
    count=$((count+1))
  else
    fail=$((fail+1))
    echo "FAIL: $pi"
    head -3 /tmp/err.txt
  fi
done
echo "compiled=$count failed=$fail"
